## SDTM VS (Vital Signs)

Core **findings-level** SDTM domain built from raw vital signs assessments to define **one record per vital sign test result per subject per timepoint**, capturing the **test code/name** (e.g., systolic/diastolic BP, pulse, temperature), **results and units** (original and standardized), and **collection/visit timing** (date/time, visit, timepoint). Optional qualifiers (e.g., **position**, **method**, **location**) add clinical context, supporting longitudinal safety review and downstream analysis.

## What you’ll find here
- **Purpose:** One record per subject per vital sign per timepoint (core timing + results)
- **Traceability:** Spec → Program → Output alignment (derivations and mappings)
- **Typical variables:** `STUDYID`, `DOMAIN`, `USUBJID`, `VSSEQ`, `VSTESTCD`, `VSTEST`, `VSORRES`, `VSORRESU`,
  `VSSTRESC`, `VSSTRESN`, `VSSTRESU`, `VSDTC`, `VISIT`, `VISITNUM`, `VSDY`, `VSTPT`, `VSTPTNUM`, `VSPOS`, `VSMETHOD`, `VSLOC`
